model.filter: 50 Hz Q30 notch + Butterworth order4 0.5-40 Hz; sliding received-data sosfiltfilt
model.normalization: rolling filtered mean/std, exclude first/last 1s of available window
model.voltage: ADC * Vref/4095, ADC input volts; electrode gain uncalibrated
model.rr: previous,next,mean(previous up to 5),previous/mean; fixed source normalization
model.r_detector: existing 4s energy QRS detector on raw ADC, with 0.4s confirmation
model.source_policy: serial/replay mode0 only; simulation/unknown modes never classified
model.quality: existing raw-ADC signal gate plus finite/quantization checks

configuration.scoring_window: full record including startup, tail, gate and rejection
configuration.reference_r_condition: reference beat positions released after 0.4s; labels never supplied; all other production gates unchanged

limitations: Fixed model, no retraining or threshold tuning
Independent execution, not a newly collected external or untouched blind test
Reference-R is a diagnostic streaming condition, not the upstream whole-record-normalization protocol
N is a beat group, not a healthy person or confirmed sinus rhythm
Scores are uncalibrated; public-data replay is not clinical validation
Runtime is local and excludes loading, network and server queues
